checks.external_comparator: SynKit recalculated; 12 byte-identical exported SBML inputs compared with recorded CRNT4SBML outputs. CRNT4SBML interpreter not rerun.
checks.production_native_build: Full workload reused the paper's verified analysis library and expander. Notebook separately built an analysis library from current sources.

comparison_exclusions.reason: Exclude runtime, environment, provenance and timing summaries; compare scientific fields, checks, counts and decisions. Structural and trajectory payloads additionally compared without numerical normalization.

findings.evidence: Reads SynKit/Experiment/CRN/results/full/crn-external-crnt4sbml.json. results/ is ignored and excluded from the source distribution. A checksum-identical archive already exists at paper/analysis/reference-1.6.3/crn-external-crnt4sbml.json but is not used as an input by this script.
findings.impact: A clean SynKit checkout plus the manuscript files cannot replay the recorded comparison through this script without first provisioning the ignored archive or rerunning the isolated legacy tool.
findings.suggested_change: Resolve the archived comparator report from the manuscript evidence bundle, or accept an explicit archive path and validate its hash.
findings.title: Recorded comparator replay depends on an ignored local result file

findings.evidence: ALL_STUDIES includes nine studies. run_all.py:213 adds hydrogen only when a native expander is available, without recording its absence in omitted_studies. Removing hydrogen from the valid paper summary still yields no errors with require_all=True.
findings.impact: A verified all-results report can omit the hydrogen results used in the paper abstract and SI.
findings.suggested_change: Define a paper-complete workload that requires hydrogen and native expansion, and verify omissions explicitly.
findings.title: Full-report verification does not require the hydrogen study

findings.evidence: The 31-network structural audit and complete plotted glycolysis trajectory are produced by manuscript-side helpers rather than Experiment/CRN/run_all.py. The notebook covers the principal glycolysis result, but is a separate execution.
findings.impact: Experiment/CRN alone covers the main studies but not every paper claim check and generated artifact.
findings.suggested_change: Document the experiment and manuscript stages explicitly; keep reusable scientific report generation in experiment studies and document rendering with the manuscript.
findings.title: The experiment runner does not produce the complete paper evidence bundle

findings.evidence: The saved full summary records version 1.6.3, commit c31b47a1abd9adb1774849aded2cc7f86e29da55. The manuscript and its analysis/ reports record 1.6.5, commit 5951b401b161187cb62095ddb136ee354a40c101.
findings.impact: A historical PASS from results/full is not evidence that the current checkout reproduced the current paper. Fresh reruns in this audit do match.
findings.title: Saved full experiment reports describe SynKit 1.6.3 rather than the paper version

findings.evidence: The local README lists seven core and two optional studies and omits native rule expansion's RDKit C++ SDK/C++20 setup. The README is ignored by the repository-wide Experiment README rule. The workflow installs Boost and runs a quick profile without provisioning an RDKit C++ SDK.
findings.impact: The documented and CI execution can omit a study included in the manuscript.
findings.suggested_change: Publish current setup instructions and a workflow or documented command for the full paper workload.
findings.title: Local reproduction instructions and CI do not provision the hydrogen workload

findings.evidence: The report requires deepest speedup > 1.0 from a single session with fixed explicit-then-Lewis order.
findings.impact: Scheduling and measurement noise can fail a scientifically correct reproduction. This audit passed the condition.
findings.suggested_change: Separate scientific equality/balance checks from performance observations, or use repeated paired measurements.
findings.title: A one-shot speed comparison is part of the scientific PASS condition

scope: Local manuscript and SI, source and report provenance, full default study workload, recorded external comparison, 31-network structural audit, glycolysis replay and notebook code. External literature and software feature-table claims were not re-audited.
